evidence.quote: Carnival Cruise Line — “The World's Most Popular Cruise Line®”
fun vacations at sea and ashore!
A “Qualifying Carnival Cruise Booking Purchase” is a Carnival Cruise
The Travel category includes purchases in a wide variety of merchant categories including: airlines, cruises, hotels and resorts
Merchants that provide transportation and related services are not included in this category, for example, airlines, hotels, car rental agencies, cruise lines

draft.notes: Cruises are travel services, not physical goods. Travel is not among the supplied categories; Bank of America places cruises under Travel, while Chase excludes cruise lines from Local transit.
